interval_years.quote: The license of every person licensed or granted prescriptive authority shall expire on June 30 of every odd-numbered year and shall be renewed biennially

required.quote: Beginning July 1, 2017, with the renewal of the licensing biennium, and every biennial renewal thereafter, each registered nurse and practical nurse licensee shall have completed one of the learning activity options recognized by the board within the two-year period preceding the renewal date

hours_per_period.quote: Thirty contact hours of continuing education activities

available.quote: The board may issue a license to practice nursing as a registered nurse by endorsement to an applicant who has been licensed as a registered nurse under the laws of another state, territory, or foreign country if the applicant has an unencumbered license and, in the opinion of the board, the applicant meets the qualifications required of registered nurses in this State at the time of graduation.

requirements.value: Applicant must have an unencumbered license from another state, territory, or foreign country and meet Hawaii's qualifications at time of graduation; pending verification, a temporary permit may be issued for employment with a Hawaii employer.

definition_quote.value: The practice of nursing as a registered nurse means the performance of professional services commensurate with the educational preparation and demonstrated competency of the individual having specialized knowledge, judgment, and skill based on the principles of the biological, physical, behavioral, and sociological sciences and nursing theory

drug_authority.value: APRNs with prescriptive authority may prescribe and administer over the counter drugs, legend drugs, and controlled substances pursuant to chapter 329; prescribe, order, and dispense medical devices and equipment; and plan and initiate a therapeutic regimen. APRNs shall not request, receive, or sign for professional controlled substance samples.

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: The director shall issue certificates to qualified nurse aides and shall be responsible for maintenance of an up-to-date nurse aide registry that shall include the names of certified nurse aides, their places of employment, and all information that is reported by the department of health and the department of human services.

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: A registered nurse may delegate nursing care tasks, functions, and activities to unlicensed assistive personnel in a manner that is appropriate to the level of knowledge and skill of the unlicensed assistive personnel

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: There is established a diversion program for chemically dependent nurses which shall be administered and monitored by a professional association or other entity approved by the board.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Services relating to the practice of nursing provided by telehealth pursuant to this chapter shall be consistent with all federal and state privacy, security, and confidentiality laws.
